backgroundExecutionChanges.scope: Subagents, Shell Tools, File read recovery, root docs/runner/loader fixture; no dependency, entry, auth, global settings or immutable source updates.
backgroundExecutionChanges.reason: User authorized async jobs to free main agent and automatically continue it on completion; exit cancels jobs. Conservative reload/session-replacement cancellation suppresses stale notifications. Read existing live logs instead of adding inspect tool; RPC control enters mainline at loop boundaries, query is disposable tool-free safe snapshot. New tool schemas are intentional additions, not unchanged source imports. Background usage is separately reported, not host-total settlement; old hosts and real providers remain unverified.

rootRunner.reason: Serialize Subagent unit files to avoid Windows 300ms fault-setup flakiness without altering assertions or production deadlines; add strict Subagent typecheck.

backgroundExecutionChanges.presentation: All five new tools retain the existing all-tool renderCall/renderResult contract. Bounded, control-safe renderers hide control/query input text, preserve model results and never imply process-tree termination; real-loader probes add exact coverage without exempting new tools.
backgroundExecutionChanges.newIds: Agent-visible job/task/control/query IDs use lowercase ULIDs from the existing root dependency; private query-channel authentication tokens are not job IDs. No persisted-data migration.
backgroundExecutionChanges.limits: No daemon, restart recovery, delivery acknowledgment, exactly-once effects, process-tree stop guarantee or OS sandbox.

contractSlimmingChanges.reason: Model-visible output/schema slimming across file, shell, subagent, web, PTY, scheduler, note and json-schema modules. Tool names, settings keys, storage directories and trust semantics preserved except documented: web_search provider argument removed; scheduler adds schedule_delete; PTY adds env allow/deny settings. See docs/migration.md.
